sentences.text: It was beautiful sunshine all weekend.
sentences.l1: Trời nắng đẹp suốt cuối tuần.

sentences.text: The flood destroyed hundreds of homes in the village.
sentences.l1: Lũ lụt đã phá hủy hàng trăm ngôi nhà trong làng.

sentences.text: After the heavy rain, there was a serious flood.
sentences.l1: Sau trận mưa lớn, có một trận lũ lụt nghiêm trọng.

sentences.text: The farmers couldn't grow food because of the drought.
sentences.l1: Nông dân không thể trồng cây vì hạn hán.

sentences.text: The drought lasted for six months and there was almost no water.
sentences.l1: Hạn hán kéo dài sáu tháng và hầu như không có nước.

sentences.text: They were playing football when lightning struck the field.
sentences.l1: Họ đang chơi bóng đá khi sét đánh xuống sân.

sentences.text: You should stay inside when there is lightning.
sentences.l1: Bạn nên ở trong nhà khi có sét.

sentences.text: The snowstorm was so bad that schools were closed.
sentences.l1: Bão tuyết quá tệ đến nỗi các trường học phải đóng cửa.

sentences.text: She was driving home when the snowstorm started.
sentences.l1: Cô ấy đang lái xe về nhà khi bão tuyết bắt đầu.

sentences.text: Malala was very determined and never stopped fighting for education.
sentences.l1: Malala rất quyết tâm và không bao giờ ngừng đấu tranh cho giáo dục.

sentences.text: You need to be determined if you want to reach your goals.
sentences.l1: Bạn cần phải quyết tâm nếu muốn đạt được mục tiêu.

sentences.text: Marie Curie was very brave because she worked with dangerous materials.
sentences.l1: Marie Curie rất dũng cảm vì bà làm việc với những vật liệu nguy hiểm.

sentences.text: It was brave of her to speak out even when it was dangerous.
sentences.l1: Thật dũng cảm khi cô ấy lên tiếng ngay cả khi điều đó nguy hiểm.

sentences.text: He was very ambitious and wanted to become the best scientist in the world.
sentences.l1: Anh ấy rất có tham vọng và muốn trở thành nhà khoa học giỏi nhất thế giới.

sentences.text: Ambitious people work hard every day to achieve their dreams.
sentences.l1: Những người có tham vọng làm việc chăm chỉ mỗi ngày để đạt được ước mơ.

sentences.text: Malala is inspirational because she helped children get an education.
sentences.l1: Malala truyền cảm hứng vì cô ấy đã giúp trẻ em được đi học.

sentences.text: Her story is inspiring to millions of young people around the world.
sentences.l1: Câu chuyện của cô ấy truyền cảm hứng cho hàng triệu bạn trẻ trên thế giới.

sentences.text: Alexander Graham Bell is famous for inventing the telephone.
sentences.l1: Alexander Graham Bell nổi tiếng với việc phát minh ra điện thoại.

sentences.text: She became famous after she won the Nobel Peace Prize.
sentences.l1: Cô ấy trở nên nổi tiếng sau khi giành được Giải Nobel Hòa bình.

sentences.text: Thomas Edison was very clever and never stopped inventing things.
sentences.l1: Thomas Edison rất thông minh và không bao giờ ngừng phát minh.

sentences.text: Her father thought she was very clever and could become a politician.
sentences.l1: Cha cô ấy nghĩ rằng cô rất thông minh và có thể trở thành chính trị gia.

sentences.text: He has insomnia and cannot fall asleep until four in the morning.
sentences.l1: Anh ấy bị mất ngủ và không thể ngủ được cho đến bốn giờ sáng.

sentences.text: Stress and too much screen time can cause insomnia.
sentences.l1: Căng thẳng và dùng màn hình quá nhiều có thể gây mất ngủ.

sentences.text: She feels stressed out because she has too much homework.
sentences.l1: Cô ấy cảm thấy căng thẳng vì có quá nhiều bài tập.

sentences.text: If you study all night, you will feel stressed out before the test.
sentences.l1: Nếu bạn học cả đêm, bạn sẽ cảm thấy căng thẳng trước kỳ thi.

sentences.text: He feels unfit because he never does any exercise.
sentences.l1: Anh ấy cảm thấy thiếu thể lực vì không bao giờ tập thể dục.

sentences.text: If you eat fast food every day, you will become unfit.
sentences.l1: Nếu bạn ăn đồ ăn nhanh mỗi ngày, bạn sẽ thiếu thể lực.

sentences.text: She is very shy and finds it hard to talk to new people.
sentences.l1: Cô ấy rất nhút nhát và thấy khó khi nói chuyện với người mới.

sentences.text: He was shy at first, but he made friends quickly.
sentences.l1: Lúc đầu anh ấy nhút nhát, nhưng nhanh chóng kết bạn được.

sentences.text: The doctor said he has some serious health problems.
sentences.l1: Bác sĩ nói rằng anh ấy có một số vấn đề sức khỏe nghiêm trọng.

sentences.text: Eating junk food and not sleeping can cause health problems.
sentences.l1: Ăn đồ ăn vặt và không ngủ đủ giấc có thể gây ra các vấn đề sức khỏe.

sentences.text: She studies too much and never gets enough rest.
sentences.l1: Cô ấy học quá nhiều và không bao giờ được nghỉ ngơi đủ.

sentences.text: If you study too much before an exam, you will feel too tired to think clearly.
sentences.l1: Nếu bạn học quá nhiều trước kỳ thi, bạn sẽ quá mệt để suy nghĩ rõ ràng.

sentences.text: You should get enough sleep every night to stay healthy.
sentences.l1: Bạn nên ngủ đủ giấc mỗi đêm để duy trì sức khỏe tốt.

sentences.text: Children who don't get enough sleep find it hard to concentrate at school.
sentences.l1: Trẻ em không ngủ đủ giấc sẽ khó tập trung ở trường.

sentences.text: She does regular exercise and always feels energetic.
sentences.l1: Cô ấy tập thể dục thường xuyên và luôn cảm thấy tràn đầy năng lượng.

sentences.text: You should do regular exercise to stay fit and healthy.
sentences.l1: Bạn nên tập thể dục thường xuyên để giữ dáng và khỏe mạnh.

sentences.text: He eats fast food every day and never cooks at home.
sentences.l1: Anh ấy ăn đồ ăn nhanh mỗi ngày và không bao giờ nấu ăn ở nhà.

sentences.text: If you eat fast food all the time, you will have health problems.
sentences.l1: Nếu bạn ăn đồ ăn nhanh mọi lúc, bạn sẽ gặp các vấn đề sức khỏe.

sentences.text: The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876.
sentences.l1: Điện thoại được phát minh bởi Alexander Graham Bell vào năm 1876.

sentences.text: Radiation was discovered by Marie Curie in the late 1800s.
sentences.l1: Phóng xạ được phát hiện bởi Marie Curie vào cuối những năm 1800.

sentences.text: The light bulb was invented by Thomas Edison.
sentences.l1: Bóng đèn được phát minh bởi Thomas Edison.

sentences.text: I was eating dinner when the volcano erupted.
sentences.l1: Tôi đang ăn tối khi núi lửa phun trào.

sentences.text: She was watching TV when the aliens invaded.
sentences.l1: Cô ấy đang xem TV khi người ngoài hành tinh xâm lăng.

sentences.text: He was sleeping when the zombies attacked.
sentences.l1: Anh ấy đang ngủ khi những xác sống tấn công.

sentences.text: We were hiding in the forest when the spaceship landed.
sentences.l1: Chúng tôi đang ẩn nấp trong rừng khi tàu vũ trụ hạ cánh.

sentences.text: You should do regular exercise instead of playing video games all night.
sentences.l1: Bạn nên tập thể dục thường xuyên thay vì chơi game cả đêm.

sentences.text: You shouldn't study all night because you need to sleep.
sentences.l1: Bạn không nên học cả đêm vì bạn cần ngủ.

sentences.text: It might rain this afternoon, so you should bring an umbrella.
sentences.l1: Có thể trời sẽ mưa chiều nay, vì vậy bạn nên mang theo ô.

sentences.text: There may be a storm tonight, so we should stay inside.
sentences.l1: Tối nay có thể có bão, vì vậy chúng ta nên ở trong nhà.

repair.broken: They was playing football when lightning striked the field.

errors.explanation: 'Strike' is irregular: past simple is 'struck', not 'striked'.

a: They were playing football when lightning struck the field.

repair.broken: The telephone was invent by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876.

errors.explanation: Passive voice needs was/were + past participle: 'was invented', not 'was invent'.

a: The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876.

repair.broken: Radiation was discover by Marie Curie in the late 1800s.

errors.explanation: Passive voice needs was/were + past participle: 'was discovered', not 'was discover'.

a: Radiation was discovered by Marie Curie in the late 1800s.

repair.broken: She was watch TV when the aliens invaded.

errors.explanation: Past continuous needs was/were + verb-ING: 'was watching', not 'was watch'.

a: She was watching TV when the aliens invaded.

repair.broken: She feel stressed out because she have too much homework.

errors.explanation: Third person singular present simple needs -s: 'she feels', not 'she feel'.
Third person singular present simple needs -s: 'she has', not 'she have'.

a: She feels stressed out because she has too much homework.

repair.broken: If you study too much before exam, you will feel too tired to think clearly.

errors.explanation: Singular countable nouns need an article: 'an exam', not 'exam'.

a: If you study too much before an exam, you will feel too tired to think clearly.

repair.broken: He was sleep when the zombies attacked.

errors.explanation: Past continuous needs was/were + verb-ING: 'was sleeping', not 'was sleep'.

a: He was sleeping when the zombies attacked.

repair.broken: You should do regular exercise to stay fit and health.

errors.explanation: 'Healthy' is the adjective form: 'stay healthy', not 'stay health'.

a: You should do regular exercise to stay fit and healthy.

transform.prompt: Write in the passive: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.
transform.broken: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.
a: The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876.
transform.explanation: Passive: object + was/were + past participle + by + agent.

transform.prompt: Write in the passive: Marie Curie discovered radiation.
a: Radiation was discovered by Marie Curie.
transform.explanation: Passive: object + was/were + past participle + by + agent.

transform.prompt: Write in the passive: Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
transform.broken: Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
a: The light bulb was invented by Thomas Edison.
transform.explanation: Passive: object + was/were + past participle + by + agent.

transform.prompt: Combine using past continuous + when: I ate dinner. The volcano erupted.
transform.broken: I ate dinner. The volcano erupted.
a: I was eating dinner when the volcano erupted.
When the volcano erupted, I was eating dinner.
transform.explanation: Past continuous (was/were + -ing) for the background action; past simple for the interruption.

transform.prompt: Combine using past continuous + when: She watched TV. The aliens invaded.
transform.broken: She watched TV. The aliens invaded.
a: She was watching TV when the aliens invaded.
When the aliens invaded, she was watching TV.
transform.explanation: Past continuous (was/were + -ing) for the background action; past simple for the interruption.
